本机已离线 · 对端看不到你: This device is offline · peers can't see you
配置都在本机后端，读回来就填上。: Settings live in the local backend and fill in once loaded.
默认 3890；被占用时自动探测 3891–3899。: 3890 by default; automatically tries 3891–3899 when taken.
打开（默认）时，接收到的推送放在以发送方名字命名的子目录里（「文件」页按“发送方: When on (default), received pushes go into a subfolder named after the sender (this is what the “sender” grouping on the Files page uses); when off, they land alongside manually downloaded files — name clashes are renamed automatically, but folders pushed by others merge into an existing folder with the same name.
直接存下载目录: Save straight to the download folder
引用下载时不再询问位置。: Downloads from references don't ask for a location.
每次弹窗选位置: Ask for a location each time
每次下载前选择保存位置。: Choose where to save before every download.
一次接收同时跑几路传输；取值 1–8，默认 4，超出范围保存时自动夹住。: How many transfers run at once while receiving; 1–8, default 4, out-of-range values are clamped on save.
大文件按它切片、片与片之间并行；取值 1–32，默认 4，超出范围保存时自动夹住: Large files are split into chunks of this size and transferred in parallel; 1–32, default 4, out-of-range values are clamped on save.
本机替别人中转累计 {size}{conn}（只算本机当中转方替别人搬的那部分，: Relayed a total of {size}{conn} for others (only the bytes this device moved as a relay; the tally continues across restarts).
还没有替别人中转 —— 有设备借本机中转之后才会有这个数。: No relaying yet — this number appears once another device relays through this one.
关掉＝隐身：停止广播、断开全部长连接，也收不到别人的推送。: Off means invisible: broadcasting stops, all live connections close, and pushes from others won't arrive.
只影响之后新添加的共享项；已经在列表里的开关一个都不动。: Only affects items added from now on; switches for items already in the list stay untouched.
电池优化：{status}。系统那一层（自启动 / 后台活动）与通知横幅都在这里: Battery optimization: {status}. The system-level parts (autostart / background activity) and notification banners are checked here — while left at the default, the app is frozen in the background: the “OrbDrop is running” notification stays up, yet peers can no longer see you.
下载完会打开系统安装器，需要你确认一次安装（非系统应用不能静默安装）。: When the download finishes the system installer opens and you confirm the install once (apps outside the system can't install silently).
收到推送并同意后，文件会落到收件目录并出现在这里。: Once you accept a push, the files land in the inbox folder and show up here.
推送或下载文件时会在这里显示进度。: Progress shows up here while pushing or downloading files.
没有处于长连接的设备: No devices with a live connection
在「设备」页选一台已配对的 PC 点「连接」，建立长连接后就能浏览它共享的目录。: On the Devices page, pick a paired PC and tap “Connect”; once a live connection is up you can browse the folders it shares.
对方还没有共享项: The other device hasn't shared anything yet
对方把目录拖入 OrbDrop 并开启广播后，就会出现在这里。: Once the other device drops a folder into OrbDrop and turns on broadcasting, it will show up here.
连接请求已发出，等它在自己的通知里点「接受」。: The connection request was sent; it needs to tap “Accept” in its notification.
确保两台设备在同一局域网，或手动添加 IP:端口。: Make sure both devices are on the same LAN, or add an IP:port manually.
点右上「＋」选一台设备开始；设备发来消息也会出现在这里。: Tap “＋” in the top right and pick a device to start; messages from devices show up here too.
替够不着彼此的其它设备搬字节（有些 Wi‑Fi 把同网段客户端之间的单播隔开），: Move bytes for other devices that can't reach each other (some Wi‑Fi networks isolate clients on the same subnet), and forward messages for group members that can't reach each other; not limited to paired devices. It uses this device's upload bandwidth (mobile data on a phone) and is on by default (enabled on first launch — turn it off if you don't want that cost); turning it off immediately stops every relay currently running for others.
界面正文与通知栏会立刻切换。首次启动使用系统语言，系统语言不在支持列表里时使用英: The interface and notifications switch immediately. The system language is used on first launch and falls back to English when the system language is not supported.
